title: Scheduled payment table record (internal)
description: This event is for internal Pismo use only. It represents a flattened DynamoDB table record for scheduled payments.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated.

aws_region.title: AWS Region
aws_region.description: AWS region where the record is stored.

processing_codes_credit.title: Processing code for credit
processing_codes_credit.description: Processing code used for credit operations.

processing_codes_debit.title: Processing code for debit
processing_codes_debit.description: Processing code used for debit operations.

type.title: Schedule type
type.description: Schedule type: SINGLE, TRANSFERS, PRE, or SCRAPING.

details_start_date.title: Details start date
details_start_date.description: Start date of the schedule in UTC-0 (RFC3339) format.

details_execution_date.title: Details execution date
details_execution_date.description: Execution date of the schedule in UTC-0 (RFC3339) format.

details_end_date.title: Details end date
details_end_date.description: End date of the schedule in UTC-0 (RFC3339) format.

details_retries_number_of_attempts.title: Details retries number of attempts
details_retries_number_of_attempts.description: Number of times to attempt executing this scheduled payment if it doesn't execute successfully.

details_retries_interval_recurrence.title: Details retries interval recurrence
details_retries_interval_recurrence.description: Time in minutes to perform the next attempt.

details_allow_execution_after_day_change.title: Details allow execution after day change
details_allow_execution_after_day_change.description: Allow execution after day change flag.

transfers.title: List of transfers
transfers.description: Array of transfer objects with flattened properties.

main_processing_code.title: Main processing code
main_processing_code.description: Processing code for the main account.

child_account_id.title: Child account ID
child_account_id.description: Account ID for the child account.

child_processing_code.title: Child processing code
child_processing_code.description: Processing code for the child account.

restrictions_minimum_available.title: Restrictions minimum available
restrictions_minimum_available.description: Execute the schedule if the available account limit is greater than or equal to this configured minimum value.

restrictions_minimum_daily_available.title: Restrictions minimum daily available
restrictions_minimum_daily_available.description: Execute the schedule if the available account limit is greater than or equal to this configured minimum value.

restrictions_minimum_monthly_average_ava.title: Restrictions minimum monthly average available
restrictions_minimum_monthly_average_ava.description: Execute the schedule if the average of monthly account limits is greater than or equal to this configured value.

restrictions_minimum_days_account_inacti.title: Restrictions minimum days account inactivity
restrictions_minimum_days_account_inacti.description: Execute the schedule if the account doesn't have any financial activity within the number of configured days.

scraping_details_available_date.title: Scraping details available date
scraping_details_available_date.description: Date and time of the cut-off moment for account scraping in UTC-0 (RFC3339) format.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Additional information relevant to the customer. Keys are dynamically flattened with metadata_ prefix.

migration_data_is_client_cancel_request.title: Migration data is client cancel request
migration_data_is_client_cancel_request.description: Flag indicating if this is a client cancel request.

pismo_metadata.title: Pismo Metadata
pismo_metadata.description: Pismo-specific metadata. Keys are dynamically flattened with pismo_metadata_ prefix.

internal_flow_for_first_execution.title: Internal flow for first execution
internal_flow_for_first_execution.description: Internal flow ID for first execution.
